messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: Canary deployment 'release/3b2' in us-west-2 exceeding 5xx threshold (3m avg 4.2% > threshold 1%). Paging on-call.

sam: got it, I'm awake. looking at dashboards.

maya: i'm on metrics — big 503 spike on /v1/generate, error rate climbing fast. traces show errors from serve-worker-*-quant pods.

sam: should we abort the canary and flip the kill switch?

ops-lead: yes if 5xx > 2% for >2min. kill-switch flag is release_canary. ops team can toggle.

sam: i'm going to toggle now.

ops-bot: Feature flag 'release_canary' set to OFF by sam at 02:12 UTC :white_check_mark:

maya: traffic shifting off canary back to stable pool — seeing immediate drop. 5xx down to ~0.9% and trending downward.

kai: kicking the rollback job for canary instances (deployctl abort-wave release/3b2). logs show termination started.

sam: can we get a quick customer impact estimate? support not seeing major pages but want numbers.

priya: query done: ~120 unique affected requests last 5m, mostly API keys from small integrations; top 10 customers account for ~60% of affected calls. no billing impact flagged yet.

ops-lead: good. keep monitoring for 15m. sam please document timeline and handoff to next on-call in 10.

sam: creating incident ticket now and attaching dashboard snapshots.

oncall: taking handoff, will watch for 30m and escalate if error rate rises. any suspicion on root cause?

maya: early signal points at KV-cache lookup churn when quantized model cold-starts under canary config. sending traces to eng-runtime.

sam: incident created: INC-2026-118. summary + logs uploaded. tagging eng-runtime and serving teams.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-118 acknowledged by oncall at 02:20 UTC :page_with_curl:

sam: leaving monitoring alerts enabled. if 5xx climbs back above 1.5% for 3m, we re-open pager.

oncall: will monitor and close if stable after 30m. handing off.

maya: follow-up action: add a quick regression test for quantized hot-starts during canary in release playbook.

sam: thanks team — keeping this blameless. ping if anything else.
